Specifications prepared using accepted engineering practices.
Pressure transmitters for HTF application with a design pressure of 500 psig and temperature of 750°F.
Instrument type is Pressure Transmitter, measuring absolute pressure with an accuracy of ± 0.1% of calibrated span.
Sensor material: Piezorresistive sensor, diaphragm and body materials are 316 SSL and 316 SS respectively.
Output signal: 4-20 mA + HART, power supply: 2-Wire / 24 VDC.
Environmental conditions range from 22°F to 125°F with special considerations for solar radiation.
Manufacturer is ABB and transmitter model details are on sheet 7.
